title: World Action Modeling with Progressive Visual Planning
title_zh: 基于渐进式视觉规划的世界动作建模

paragraphs.en: World action models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic control by jointly predicting future visual dynamics and actions from an initial observation and instruction. However, existing WAMs struggle with long-horizon prediction, as generating dense video rollouts is highly inefficient. Some recent WAMs address this by predicting a single future frame without generating the full video, but this approach neglects how to progress toward the goal. We present ProWAM , a progressive world action model that jointly predicts actions and an ordered sequence of sparse visual sub-goals, providing explicit visual guidance to anchor action generation throughout task execution. This design scales naturally, as sub-goal prediction can be learned from large-scale action-free videos, allowing the video backbone to offload complex visual planning from the action policy. For efficient action generation, ProWAM executes a single video-backbone forward pass to cache sparse sub-goal features, eliminating iterative full-video generation and requiring only lightweight action denoising during replanning. Across extensive evaluations, ProWAM achieves superior out-of-distribution robustness. On simulation benchmarks, it sets new state-of-the-art results on LIBERO-Plus (85.8%) and randomized RoboTwin (75.7%), outperforming the strongest baseline with relative gains of up to +35.9% . On RoboCasa365, ProWAM achieves a 48.1% success rate and 18.2% on the challenging Composite-Unseen split, ranking 4th overall . Crucially, in zero-shot real-world experiments, ProWAM achieves 70.0% success, outperforming the strongest baseline by +15.0 (from 55.0% to 70.0%, a +27.3% relative gain) in novel scenes. These results demonstrate the value of progress-indexed visual foresight for closed-loop control.
paragraphs.zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）已成为机器人控制领域一种前景广阔的范式，它能够通过初始观察和指令联合预测未来的视觉动态与动作。 然而，现有的 WAMs 难以进行长期预测，因为生成密集的视频序列效率极低。 一些近期的 WAMs 通过仅预测单个未来帧而非生成完整视频来解决这一问题，但这种方法忽略了如何逐步向目标推进。 我们提出了 ProWAM——一种渐进式世界动作模型，它能联合预测动作与有序的稀疏视觉子目标序列，从而在整个任务执行过程中提供明确的视觉指导以锚定动作生成。 这种设计具有天然的可扩展性，因为子目标预测可以从大规模无动作视频中学习，使视频主干网络能够将复杂的视觉规划从动作策略中分离出来。 为了实现高效的动作生成，ProWAM 仅执行一次视频主干网络的前向传播以缓存稀疏的子目标特征，从而避免了迭代生成完整视频，并在重新规划时仅需轻量级的动作降噪操作。 在广泛的评估中，ProWAM 展现出卓越的分布外鲁棒性。 在模拟基准测试中，它在 LIBERO-Plus（85.8%）和随机化 RoboTwin（75.7%）上创造了新的最先进水平，相较于最强基线模型的最大相对提升高达 +35.9%。 在 RoboCasa365 上，ProWAM 取得了 48.1% 的成功率，并在具有挑战性的 Composite-Unseen 分割集上达到 18.2%，总排名第四。 尤为关键的是，在零样本的真实世界实验中，ProWAM 在新型场景中的成功率为 70.0%，比最强基线模型高出 +15.0（从 55.0% 提升至 70.0%，相对提升 +27.3%）。 这些结果证明了基于进展索引的视觉预见性在闭环控制中的价值。

paragraphs.en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models primarily inherit semantic knowledge from vision-language pretraining but remain data-hungry due to their reliance on large, costly collections of robot demonstrations ( Kim et al., 2024 ; Black et al., 2024 ; Black et al., 2025 ) . In contrast, world action models (WAMs) introduce a complementary source of transferable knowledge: visual-dynamics priors learned by video generation models from large-scale video datasets ( Blattmann et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Wan et al., 2025 ) . Recent WAMs have shown that incorporating such predictive visual knowledge can improve data efficiency and out-of-distribution generalization in robotic control ( Pai et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2026c ; Yuan et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型主要从视觉-语言预训练中继承语义知识，但由于其依赖大规模且成本高昂的机器人演示数据集，因此仍然需要大量数据（Kim et al., 2024；Black et al., 2024；Black et al., 2025）。 相比之下，世界动作模型（WAMs）引入了一种互补的可迁移知识来源：视频生成模型从大规模视频数据集中学习到的视觉动态先验（Blattmann et al., 2023；Yang et al., 2024；Wan et al., 2025）。 近期的WAM研究表明，融入此类预测性视觉知识可以提升机器人控制中的数据效率以及分布外泛化能力（Pai et al., 2025；Ye et al., 2026c；Yuan et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026b；Li et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Existing WAMs differ in how they utilize future visual prediction to guide action generation. Full-imagination WAMs ( Pai et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2026c ; Li et al., 2026 ) leverage dense future rollouts that provide detailed near-term guidance but are inefficient as they require multiple denoising passes through a large video backbone. Alternatively, zero-imagination WAMs ( Yuan et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026a ) generate actions without predicting future visual states. Between these extremes, ImageWAM ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) conditions control on an action-horizon endpoint frame without explicitly representing intermediate visual states. These designs reveal a fundamental trade-off: dense visual rollouts provide short-horizon dynamics at high computational cost, whereas other efficient alternatives lack explicit intermediate-progress guidance over the full task.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的 WAM 在如何利用未来视觉预测来指导动作生成方面存在差异。 全想象型 WAM（Pai 等，2025；Ye 等，2026c；Li 等，2026）利用密集的未来展开序列提供详细的短期指导，但由于需要多次通过大型视频主干网络进行去噪，因此效率低下。 相比之下，零想象型 WAM（Yuan 等，2026；Ye 等，2026a）在无需预测未来视觉状态的情况下生成动作。 在这两种极端之间，ImageWAM（Zhang 等，2026b）将控制条件设定在动作视界的终点帧上，而无需显式表示中间视觉状态。 这些设计揭示了一个根本性的权衡：密集的视觉展开序列以高昂的计算成本提供短期动态信息，而其他高效的替代方案则缺乏在整个任务过程中对中间进展的明确指导。

paragraphs.en: To reconcile this trade-off, we introduce ProWAM , a progressive world action model that extends a single fixed-state prediction into an ordered sequence of sparse visual sub-goals. Each sub-goal is indexed by normalized progress relative to the current state, where r = 0 r=0 denotes the current observation and r = 1 r=1 denotes the trajectory endpoint. This relative parameterization dynamically re-anchors sub-goals to the current observation, enabling consistent guidance across arbitrary task stages and varying trajectory lengths. Consequently, these sparse targets efficiently guide action generation without requiring dense video rollouts or separate high-level planning modules.
paragraphs.zh: 为了平衡这一权衡，我们提出了 ProWAM——一种渐进式世界动作模型，它将单一固定状态的预测扩展为一系列有序的稀疏视觉子目标。 每个子目标都通过相对于当前状态的归一化进度进行索引，其中 r = 0 表示当前观测结果，而 r = 1 表示轨迹的终点。 这种相对参数化方法能够动态地将子目标重新锚定到当前观测结果上，从而在任意任务阶段和不同轨迹长度下实现一致的引导。 因此，这些稀疏目标能够高效地指导动作生成，而无需依赖密集的视频展开或独立的高级规划模块。

paragraphs.en: Specifically, ProWAM adopts a vision-action mixture-of-transformers (MoT) architecture consisting of a video generation expert and a lightweight diffusion-based action expert for policy generation. Each visual sub-goal is represented as a latent slot associated with a normalized progress value. The video expert jointly predicts near-term future transitions and progress-conditioned sub-goals, while the action expert attends to current observations and sub-goals to generate low-level action chunks. Asymmetric attention prevents action information from altering the visual prediction pathway. This design preserves the generative prior of the video expert, enabling video-only pretraining on large-scale action-free videos followed by joint fine-tuning on task-specific robot demonstrations to couple visual planning with action generation. At inference, ProWAM reuses cached sub-goal features to eliminate repeated video-backbone computation, enabling efficient closed-loop control. Overall, our contributions are threefold:
paragraphs.zh: 具体而言，ProWAM 采用了一种视觉-动作混合变换器（MoT）架构，该架构由一个视频生成专家和一个基于扩散的轻量级动作专家组成，用于策略生成。 每个视觉子目标都被表示为一个与归一化进度值相关联的潜在槽位。 视频专家共同预测近期的未来状态转移和以进度为条件的子目标，而动作专家则关注当前观察结果和子目标，以生成低级别的动作片段。 非对称注意力机制可防止动作信息改变视觉预测路径。 这种设计保留了视频专家的生成先验，使其能够先在无动作的大规模视频上进行仅视频的预训练，随后在特定任务的机器人演示上进行联合微调，从而将视觉规划与动作生成耦合起来。 在推理阶段，ProWAM 会复用缓存的子目标特征，以消除重复的视频主干计算，从而实现高效的闭环控制。 总体而言，我们的贡献有三方面：

paragraphs.en: To enable explicit visual planning in WAM, a natural baseline is final-goal prediction (FGP) 1 1 1 Our pilot study finds that self-generated final goal improves baselines in most settings (Appendix A ). . However, compressing an entire episode into a solitary final frame specifies where the task terminates but provides no guidance on how to get there, leaving the intermediate execution path unspecified. Inspired by hierarchical planning paradigms that decompose extended horizons into structured sub-states/goals ( Li et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2026c ) , we introduce a progressive sub-goal signal directly into the WAM architecture. Specifically, we generalize FGP into a progressive sequence of sparse k k sub-goals that predicts an ordered sequence of sparse sub-goals at selected relative future positions, yielding our progressive world action model ( ProWAM ). Crucially, while classical hierarchical planners ( Ai et al., 2026 ; Shou et al., 2026 ) depend on dedicated, multi-stage goal-generation modules, ProWAM generates the entire sub-goal trajectory natively and injects their features directly to the action expert (as shown in Figure 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了在 WAM 中实现显式的视觉规划，一个自然的基线方法是最终目标预测（FGP）1 1 1 我们的初步研究发现，在大多数设置中，自生成的最终目标能够提升基线方法的表现（附录 A）。 然而，将整个时间步压缩为单个最终帧虽然明确了任务的终止位置，但并未提供如何到达该位置的指导，因此中间的执行路径仍然未定。 受启发于将长期规划分解为结构化子状态/目标的层次化规划范式（Li et al., 2023; Luo et al., 2026c），我们将渐进式子目标信号直接引入 WAM 架构。 具体而言，我们将 FGP 推广为一个稀疏的 k 个 k 个子目标的渐进序列，该序列在选定的相对未来位置预测出一系列有序的稀疏子目标，由此形成了我们的渐进世界动作模型（ProWAM）。 关键在于，尽管传统的层次化规划方法（Ai et al., 2026; Shou et al., 2026）依赖专门的、多阶段的目标生成模块，而 ProWAM 则原生地生成完整的子目标轨迹，并将其特征直接注入到动作专家中（如图 2 所示）。

paragraphs.en: Rather than performing burdensome joint video-action denoising that advances the video and action branches synchronously across T T steps ( Ye et al., 2026c ) , we empirically find that sub-goal features obtained from a single video-expert evaluation support comparable policy performance to full joint denoising (Appendix C ). At each replanning step, we evaluate 𝒱 \mathcal{V} once to predict the sub-goals and cache their key–value features. The action head then reuses this fixed cache throughout T T action-denoising steps. Upon receiving a new observation, ProWAM recomputes the sub-goals and refreshes the cache. This reduces video-expert forward passes from T T to 1 1 ( ≈ 10 × \approx 10\times fewer video-expert evaluations), achieving inference cost comparable to prior cached WAMs ( Pai et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 与其执行繁重的联合视频-动作去噪任务，该任务需要在 T 个步骤中同步推进视频和动作分支（Ye et al., 2026c），我们的经验表明，通过单次视频专家评估获得的子目标特征所支持的政策性能与完整的联合去噪相当（附录 C）。 在每个重新规划步骤中，我们仅对 𝒱 \mathcal{V} 进行一次评估以预测子目标，并缓存其键-值特征。 随后，动作头在整个 T 个动作去噪步骤中重复使用这个固定的缓存。 在接收到新的观察结果后，ProWAM 会重新计算子目标并刷新缓存。 这将视频专家的推理次数从 T 次减少到 1 次（即减少了约 10 倍的视频专家评估），从而实现了与先前缓存的 WAM 方法（Pai et al., 2025；Yuan et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026b）相当的推理成本。

paragraphs.en: Following the evaluation protocols in concurrent works ( Black et al., 2025 ; Bu et al., 2025b ; Yuan et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026a ) , we adopt several prevailing benchmarks for in-domain (ID) and out-of-domain (OOD) simulation evaluation, including LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) & LIBERO-Plus ( Fei et al., 2025 ) , RoboTwin ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , and RoboCasa365 ( Nasiriany et al., 2024 ) , alongside zero-shot real-world robot deployments on Franka. We strictly follow the standard evaluation metrics tailored for each benchmark and report the average success rate for each task. Our ProWAM adopts the Wan2.2-TI2V-5B ( Wan et al., 2025 ) as the video backbone. Since our sub-goal-conditioned prediction relies on a strong visual world prior, we study two paradigms that differ in the strength of that prior: (i) ProWAM-Base , initialized directly from the Wan base model (w/o Stage-1 ). (ii) ProWAM , initialized from a video-only paradigm pretrained on large-scale robot and egocentric data (see Appendix B for details). The video branch still generates sub-goals as an auxiliary co-training objective, so the shared representation remains sub-goal-aware. At inference, the action expert does not require fully denoised sub-goal latents but conditions on sub-goal key-value features cached from a single video-expert evaluation, yielding a simpler and faster policy. Additional experimental details are deferred to Appendix C & D .

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 compares sub-goals generated immediately before release in successful and failed “Cube Stacking” rollouts. paragraphs.en: To evaluate computational efficiency, we benchmark inference latency and FLOPs for a 16 16 -action chunk on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU. Compared with naive joint denoising ( 115.5 115.5 TFLOPs, 581 581 ms), our KV-cache strategy reduces computation to 18.7 18.7 TFLOPs ( 84 % 84\% reduction) and latency to 313 313 ms ( 46 % 46\% reduction), while achieving 3.3 percentage points higher OOD success in this evaluation. As shown in Figure 4 (a), ProWAM achieves a favorable trade-off between computational efficiency and robustness: while in-distribution performance remains similar across methods, ProWAM reaches 75.7 % 75.7\% OOD success under domain randomization, outperforming other methods at comparable or lower computational cost.
paragraphs.zh: 为评估计算效率，我们在单块 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上对包含 16×16 个动作的片段进行了推理延迟和 FLOPs 基准测试。 与简单的联合去噪方法（115.5 TFLOPs，581 ms）相比，我们的 KV-cache 策略将计算量降至 18.7 TFLOPs（减少 84%），延迟降至 313 ms（减少 46%），同时在此评估中实现了高出 3.3 个百分点的 OOD 成功率。 如图 4(a) 所示，ProWAM 在计算效率与鲁棒性之间实现了理想的权衡：尽管各方法在分布内性能表现相似，但在领域随机化条件下，ProWAM 的 OOD 成功率达到了 75.7%，以相当或更低的计算成本超越了其他方法。

paragraphs.en: Generative video priors ( Blattmann et al., 2023 ; Wan et al., 2025 ) have spurred the development of world action models (WAMs), which leverage visual foresight to condition robotic policies ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Early frameworks adopted cascaded pipelines, first predicting future visual states and subsequently recovering actions via inverse dynamics or learned policies ( Du et al., 2023 ; Bharadhwaj et al., 2024 ) . Modern WAMs tightly unify predictive modeling and action generation within joint diffusion objectives and shared architectures ( Kim et al., 2026b ; Bi et al., 2026 ) . These approaches form an imagination spectrum according to the future visual context used for action generation. Full-imagination WAMs ( Pai et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2026c ; Li et al., 2026 ) condition actions on dense generated video rollouts, providing detailed short-horizon guidance at high computational cost. In contrast, zero-imagination WAMs ( Yuan et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026a ) use no predicted future visual states during inference. Between them, Zhang et al. (2026b) conditions action generation on a single future target. ProWAM instead predicts a variable-length sequence of future visual states indexed by relative progress, providing guidance at multiple selected stages of the remaining trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 生成式视频先验（Blattmann 等人，2023；Wan 等人，2025）推动了世界动作模型（WAMs）的发展，这些模型利用视觉前瞻性来约束机器人策略（Wang 等人，2026）。 早期的框架采用了级联式流程：首先预测未来的视觉状态，随后通过逆动力学或学习到的策略恢复动作（Du 等人，2023；Bharadhwaj 等人，2024）。 现代 WAMs 将预测建模与动作生成紧密统一在联合扩散目标和共享架构中（Kim 等人，2026b；Bi 等人，2026）。 这些方法根据用于动作生成的未来视觉上下文，构成了一个想象力的连续谱。 全想象力 WAMs（Pai 等人，2025；Ye 等人，2026c；Li 等人，2026）将动作约束在密集生成的视频展开序列上，从而以高昂的计算成本提供详细的短期引导。 相比之下，零想象力 WAMs（Yuan 等人，2026；Ye 等人，2026a）在推理过程中不使用任何预测的未来视觉状态。 在这两者之间，Zhang 等人 （2026b）将动作生成约束于单一的未来目标。 ProWAM 则预测由相对进度索引的未来视觉状态的变长序列，从而在剩余轨迹的多个选定阶段提供引导。

paragraphs.en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models transfer semantic priors from multimodal pretraining ( Bai et al., 2025 ) to robotic action generation by mapping task instructions and visual observations to actions ( Ma et al., 2026 ) . Building on generalist models ( Kim et al., 2024 ; Team et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) , existing VLAs represent actions using either discrete tokens ( Zitkovich et al., 2023 ; Pertsch et al., 2025 ) or continuous diffusion and flow-matching objectives ( Black et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Chi et al., 2025 ) . For long-horizon tasks, recent hierarchical VLAs additionally introduce textual sub-instructions, multimodal reasoning traces, or visual sub-goals ( Belkhale et al., 2024 ; Ai et al., 2026 ; Shou et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ) . While effective, many of these approaches rely on decoupled high-level modules or multi-stage inference pipelines, increasing computational complexity and inducing cascading error propagation across stages. ProWAM instead natively predicts progressive visual sub-goals within its video-generation pathway and directly couples them to action generation inside a unified WAM.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过将任务指令和视觉观察结果映射到具体动作，将多模态预训练中的语义先验知识迁移到机器人动作生成中（Bai 等，2025；Ma 等，2026）。 在通用模型（Kim 等，2024；Team 等，2024；Liu 等，2024）的基础上，现有的 VLA 模型使用离散标记（Zitkovich 等，2023；Pertsch 等，2025）或连续的扩散和流匹配目标（Black 等，2024；Liu 等，2024；Chi 等，2025）来表示动作。 对于长时域任务，近期的分层 VLA 模型还引入了文本子指令、多模态推理痕迹或视觉子目标（Belkhale 等，2024；Ai 等，2026；Shou 等，2026；Chen 等，2026b）。 尽管这些方法效果显著，但许多方法依赖于解耦的高层模块或多阶段推理流程，从而增加了计算复杂度，并导致各阶段之间出现级联错误传播。 相比之下，ProWAM 在其视频生成路径中直接预测渐进式的视觉子目标，并在统一的 WAM 框架内将其与动作生成直接耦合。

paragraphs.en: Directly executing long-horizon manipulation through unconditioned action policies often suffers from compounding trajectory drift. Decomposing complex tasks into intermediate visual sub-goals provides structured foresight, simplifying long-horizon control into manageable visual milestones ( Li et al., 2023 ; Xie et al., 2026 ) . Existing approaches incorporate such foresight either through standalone goal-generation modules ( Shou et al., 2026 ) or via online model-based trajectory search over candidate rollouts ( Neary et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) . Nevertheless, modular goal generators remain vulnerable to error propagation across decoupled stages, while online trajectory search introduces prohibitive computational latency for real-time control. ProWAM instead integrates progress-conditioned sub-goal prediction and action generation through shared attention, reusing cached sub-goal features during iterative action denoising without requiring a separate planner or online trajectory search.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we introduced ProWAM, a world action model that integrates visual planning and physical control within a unified generative framework. Motivated by hierarchical policies that decompose long-horizon tasks into intermediate sub-goal states, we incorporate progressive visual sub-goal prediction directly into the world-modeling process without requiring a separate high-level planner. Specifically, ProWAM uses a generative video expert to predict visual sub-goals indexed by relative temporal progress and couples their features to low-level action generation, without auxiliary modules or test-time search. Moreover, the unified architecture supports pretraining on large-scale action-free videos followed by joint vision-action fine-tuning, allowing visual dynamics learned without action labels to inform downstream action generation. Evaluations across simulation benchmarks and four physical manipulation tasks show strong performance under the evaluated in-domain, randomized, and held-out long horizon settings. Overall, our results support progressive visual prediction as an effective interface between visual imagination and robotic control.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 ProWAM——一种将视觉规划与物理控制整合到统一生成框架中的世界动作模型。 受启发于将长期任务分解为中间子目标状态的层级策略，我们将渐进式视觉子目标预测直接融入世界建模过程，无需独立的顶层规划器。 具体而言，ProWAM 使用一个生成式视频专家来预测以相对时间进度为索引的视觉子目标，并将其特征与低层动作生成相耦合，无需辅助模块或测试时的搜索。 此外，该统一架构支持在大规模无动作视频上进行预训练，随后进行视觉与动作的联合微调，使得无需动作标签即可学习的视觉动态能够指导下游的动作生成。 在模拟基准测试以及四项物理操控任务中的评估表明，ProWAM 在受评估的领域内、随机化以及长期保留设置下均表现出强劲性能。 总体而言，我们的研究结果支持将渐进式视觉预测作为连接视觉想象与机器人控制的有效接口。

sents.zh: 具体而言，ProWAM 使用一个生成式视频专家来预测以相对时间进度为索引的视觉子目标，并将其特征与低层动作生成相耦合，无需辅助模块或测试时的搜索。

sents.en: Moreover, the unified architecture supports pretraining on large-scale action-free videos followed by joint vision-action fine-tuning, allowing visual dynamics learned without action labels to inform downstream action generation.
sents.zh: 此外，该统一架构支持在大规模无动作视频上进行预训练，随后进行视觉与动作的联合微调，使得无需动作标签即可学习的视觉动态能够指导下游的动作生成。

sents.en: Evaluations across simulation benchmarks and four physical manipulation tasks show strong performance under the evaluated in-domain, randomized, and held-out long horizon settings.
sents.zh: 在模拟基准测试以及四项物理操控任务中的评估表明，ProWAM 在受评估的领域内、随机化以及长期保留设置下均表现出强劲性能。

sents.en: Overall, our results support progressive visual prediction as an effective interface between visual imagination and robotic control.
sents.zh: 总体而言，我们的研究结果支持将渐进式视觉预测作为连接视觉想象与机器人控制的有效接口。

paragraphs.en: Data Recipe. The goal of this stage is to endow the policy with a strong, embodiment-aligned visual dynamics prior before any action learning, so that the subsequent action head can be grounded in an already-capable video predictor rather than learned from scratch. To this end, ProWAM is obtained through a video-only pretraining stage that adapts a large-scale video prior to the target robot embodiment before any action learning. Similar to training strategy in Luo et al. (2026a) ; Wu and Gao (2026) , we build on the Wan2.2-TI2V-5B video diffusion transformer, initialized from a checkpoint pretrained on large-scale robot video data, a mixture of DROID ( Ye et al., 2026c ) , AgiBott-Beta ( Bu et al., 2025a ) filtered from ( Wu and Gao, 2026 ) , and 57 tasks from OpenX-Embodiment ( O’Neill et al., 2024 ) with a ratio of 60 % / 30 % / 10 % 60\%/30\%/10\% . This endows general-purpose Wan with a task-level sub-goal prior for robotic manipulation. To monitor generalization we hold out a fixed, seed-deterministic set of 400 episodes (200 DROID + 200 AgiBot), excluded from training, and evaluate the forward-only flow-matching loss on them every 500 steps.
paragraphs.zh: 数据配方。本阶段的目标是在任何动作学习之前，为策略赋予一个与具身化高度契合的强视觉动态先验，以便后续的动作头能够基于一个已具备能力的视频预测模型进行构建，而非从头开始学习。为此，ProWAM 通过一个仅使用视频的预训练阶段获得，该阶段将大规模视频先验适配到目标机器人具身化上，且在此之前未进行任何动作学习。与 Luo et al. (2026a)；Wu and Gao (2026) 中的训练策略类似，我们基于 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 视频扩散变换器进行构建，其初始参数来自一个在大规模机器人视频数据上预训练的检查点。该数据集混合了 DROID（Ye et al., 2026c）、从（Wu and Gao, 2026）中筛选出的 AgiBott-Beta（Bu et al., 2025a），以及来自 OpenX-Embodiment（O’Neill et al., 2024）的 57 个任务，比例分别为 60% / 30% / 10%（60\%/30\%/10\%）。这使得通用 Wan 具备用于机器人操作的任务级子目标先验。为监控泛化能力，我们保留了一个固定的、由种子确定的 400 个剧集（200 个 DROID + 200 个 AgiBot）作为验证集，这些剧集未参与训练，并且每 500 步对其评估一次仅前向传播的流程匹配损失。

paragraphs.en: Resolution and Multi-View Composition. Each training clip contains 25 25 frames rendered at 512 × 512 512\times 512 . Because the source datasets differ in the number of available camera views, we render every episode into a single composite frame whose layout is selected automatically from the dataset’s native view count (depth streams excluded, and capped at four views): a single view fills the whole frame; two views are placed left ∣ \mid right (each W 2 × H \tfrac{W}{2}\times H ); three views use a top-1/bottom-2 layout (view 0 spanning the top half at W × H 2 W\times\tfrac{H}{2} , the other two tiled below, each W 2 × H 2 \tfrac{W}{2}\times\tfrac{H}{2} ); and four views form a 2 × 2 2\times 2 grid (each cell W 2 × H 2 \tfrac{W}{2}\times\tfrac{H}{2} ). Each view is letterboxed into its cell with aspect ratio preserved (rather than stretched), avoiding spatial distortion. This yields a fixed-size observation interface that handles single- and multi-view episodes uniformly, and lets a single model learn across heterogeneous camera rigs without per-dataset architectural changes.
paragraphs.zh: 分辨率与多视角构图。 每个训练片段包含 25 帧以 512 × 512 渲染的图像。 由于源数据集的可用摄像头视角数量不同，我们将每一集渲染为单个合成帧，其布局从数据集的原生视角数量中自动选择（不包括深度流，且最多限制为四个视角）：单视角占据整个画面；双视角分别置于左侧 ∣ 右侧（每个尺寸为 W/2 × H）；三视角采用“上1/下2”布局（视角0占据上半部分，尺寸为 W × H/2，其余两个视角在下方平铺，每个尺寸为 W/2 × H/2）；四视角则构成一个 2 × 2 网格（每个单元格尺寸为 W/2 × H/2）。 每个视角均通过保留宽高比的字母盒方式嵌入其单元格中（而非拉伸），从而避免空间失真。 这样便得到了一个固定尺寸的观察界面，能够统一处理单视角和多视角的片段，并使单个模型无需针对不同数据集修改架构即可跨异构摄像头系统学习。

paragraphs.en: At this stage no action head is attached, so the model is trained purely as a flow-matching video predictor. The key ingredient is progressive sub-goal conditioning : for each clip we sample up to K = 8 K{=}8 future sub-goal frames from the same trajectory at relative progress positions (via coverage sampling, which spreads sub-goals across the horizon rather than clustering them), and condition the predictor on them jointly with the current observation. Sub-goals are injected with a zeroed rotary position and referenced relative to the first frame, and the clip loss is computed bidirectionally. The sub-goal and clip losses are weighted equally, both set to 1 1 . Training the video model to forecast frames toward sampled sub-goals is precisely what instills the task-level sub-goal prior that ProWAM later reuses for action prediction. We set λ video = λ sub = 1 \lambda_{\mathrm{video}}=\lambda_{\mathrm{sub}}=1 .

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 8 , the pretrained video expert predicts sub-goals that advance coherently with the progress value r r . As r r increases from 0.1 0.1 to 0.9 0.9 , the generated frames depict the manipulation progressing toward task completion, such as approaching, grasping, and transporting the target object, and qualitatively align with the corresponding ground-truth frames on the training embodiments. paragraphs.en: LIBERO & LIBERO-Plus. Standard LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) consists of four single-arm tabletop manipulation suites (Spatial, Object, Goal, and Long), each featuring 10 tasks and 500 expert demonstrations. We train our policy across all four standard suites and report the average success rate (ASR) over 50 evaluation trials per task, yielding a total of 2000 trials across 40 tasks. LIBERO-Plus ( Fei et al., 2025 ) introduces a more challenging setting built upon the original LIBERO tasks, incorporating diverse perturbations (camera, robot, language, lighting, background, sensor noise, and layout). We use only the original LIBERO demonstrations for training and do not incorporate any LIBERO-Plus data, which is used exclusively for zero-shot generalization evaluation. We evaluate under the LIBERO-Plus protocol with ASR. We use all four LIBERO suites, with the original 50 demonstrations per task. Observations are the agent-view and wrist cameras composited side-by-side at 224 × 448 224\times 448 . Stage 1 performs video-only adaptation from the pretrained expert for 9 epochs, the resulting checkpoint initializes the video expert for Stage 2, which co-trains the action head for another 10 epochs. Unless otherwise noted, our best model uses a single sub-goal ( k = 1 k{=}1 ) at progress r = 0.7 r{=}0.7 .
paragraphs.zh: LIBERO & LIBERO-Plus。 标准版 LIBERO（Liu 等人，2023）包含四个单臂桌面操作套件（Spatial、Object、Goal 和 Long），每个套件各有 10 个任务和 500 条专家演示。 我们在所有四个标准套件上训练策略，并报告每个任务在 50 次评估试验中的平均成功率（ASR），总计 40 个任务共 2000 次试验。 LIBERO-Plus（Fei 等人，2025）在原始 LIBERO 任务基础上引入更具挑战性的设定，加入了多种扰动（摄像头、机器人、语言、光照、背景、传感器噪声和布局）。 我们仅使用原始 LIBERO 的演示数据进行训练，未引入任何 LIBERO-Plus 数据，后者仅用于零样本泛化评估。 我们按照 LIBERO-Plus 协议并使用 ASR 进行评估。 我们使用全部四个 LIBERO 套件，每个任务采用原始的 50 条演示数据。 观测数据为智能体视角摄像头与手腕摄像头拼接而成，分辨率为 224 × 448。 第一阶段基于预训练的专家模型仅通过视频进行 9 个周期的自适应训练；所得检查点用于初始化第二阶段的视频专家模型，该阶段再联合训练动作头 10 个周期。 除非另有说明，我们的最佳模型在进度 r = 0.7 时仅使用一个子目标（k = 1）。

sents.en: Standard LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) consists of four single-arm tabletop manipulation suites (Spatial, Object, Goal, and Long), each featuring 10 tasks and 500 expert demonstrations.
sents.zh: 标准版 LIBERO（Liu 等人，2023）包含四个单臂桌面操作套件（Spatial、Object、Goal 和 Long），每个套件各有 10 个任务和 500 条专家演示。

sents.en: We train our policy across all four standard suites and report the average success rate (ASR) over 50 evaluation trials per task, yielding a total of 2000 trials across 40 tasks.
sents.zh: 我们在所有四个标准套件上训练策略，并报告每个任务在 50 次评估试验中的平均成功率（ASR），总计 40 个任务共 2000 次试验。

sents.en: LIBERO-Plus ( Fei et al., 2025 ) introduces a more challenging setting built upon the original LIBERO tasks, incorporating diverse perturbations (camera, robot, language, lighting, background, sensor noise, and layout).
sents.zh: LIBERO-Plus（Fei 等人，2025）在原始 LIBERO 任务基础上引入更具挑战性的设定，加入了多种扰动（摄像头、机器人、语言、光照、背景、传感器噪声和布局）。

sents.en: We use only the original LIBERO demonstrations for training and do not incorporate any LIBERO-Plus data, which is used exclusively for zero-shot generalization evaluation.
sents.zh: 我们仅使用原始 LIBERO 的演示数据进行训练，未引入任何 LIBERO-Plus 数据，后者仅用于零样本泛化评估。

sents.en: We evaluate under the LIBERO-Plus protocol with ASR.
sents.zh: 我们按照 LIBERO-Plus 协议并使用 ASR 进行评估。

sents.en: We use all four LIBERO suites, with the original 50 demonstrations per task.
sents.zh: 我们使用全部四个 LIBERO 套件，每个任务采用原始的 50 条演示数据。

sents.en: Observations are the agent-view and wrist cameras composited side-by-side at 224 × 448 224\times 448 .
sents.zh: 观测数据为智能体视角摄像头与手腕摄像头拼接而成，分辨率为 224 × 448。

sents.en: Stage 1 performs video-only adaptation from the pretrained expert for 9 epochs, the resulting checkpoint initializes the video expert for Stage 2, which co-trains the action head for another 10 epochs.
sents.zh: 第一阶段基于预训练的专家模型仅通过视频进行 9 个周期的自适应训练；所得检查点用于初始化第二阶段的视频专家模型，该阶段再联合训练动作头 10 个周期。

sents.en: Unless otherwise noted, our best model uses a single sub-goal ( k = 1 k{=}1 ) at progress r = 0.7 r{=}0.7 .
sents.zh: 除非另有说明，我们的最佳模型在进度 r = 0.7 时仅使用一个子目标（k = 1）。

paragraphs.en: RoboTwin. RoboTwin ( Chen et al., 2025 ) is a large-scale simulated benchmark for bimanual robot manipulation, which covers 50 tasks and requires policies to coordinate under diverse object layouts and scene conditions. Specifically, it provides 2,500 trajectories collected in clean scenes and 25,000 trajectories collected with heavy scene randomization. In contrast to prior work that trains on both ( Yuan et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026 ) , we train our policy exclusively on the 2,500 clean-scene demonstrations (Clean) and treat the randomized scenes (Random) as an out-of-distribution test to scrutinize the model’s cross-domain generalization, reporting ASR over 100 trials per task. We use all 50 RoboTwin tasks under the multi-task setting, training on the 50 clean demonstrations per task. The randomized split evaluates control generalization without randomized-scene action supervision. Following ( Chen et al., 2026a ; Hu et al., 2026 ) , the video expert is trained with action-free videos from both clean and randomized scenes, whereas vision-action fine-tuning uses only clean demonstrations. The randomized split therefore evaluates whether visual knowledge learned without action labels can support action generation under substantial scene variation. Observations are the head and two wrist cameras composited into a single frame at 384 × 320 384\times 320 (head on the top two-thirds, left/right wrist on the bottom). We follow the same two-stage recipe as LIBERO, with three differences: (i) a three-camera RoboTwin composite instead of two, (ii) a small cold-start (RoboTwin is roughly 24 × 24\times larger than LIBERO, so video-only adaptation runs about 1 1 epoch), and (iii) the best sub-goal schedule is near-biased with a higher k k ( K = 4 K{=}4 , progress 0.1 , 0.2 , 0.35 , 0.5 {0.1,0.2,0.35,0.5} ). Stage 2 co-trains the action head for 5 epochs on the clean split with the same differential learning rate.
paragraphs.zh: RoboTwin。 RoboTwin（Chen 等人，2025）是一个用于双手机器人操作的大规模模拟基准测试，涵盖 50 项任务，并要求策略能够在多样化的物体布局和场景条件下进行协调。 具体来说，它提供了在干净场景中收集的 2,500 条轨迹，以及在高度随机化的场景中收集的 25,000 条轨迹。 与在两种数据上训练的先前工作（Yuan 等人，2026；Zhang 等人，2026b；Li 等人，2026）不同，我们仅使用 2,500 条干净场景的演示（Clean）来训练策略，并将随机化场景（Random）视为分布外的测试集，以检验模型的跨域泛化能力，并报告每个任务在 100 次试验中的 ASR。 我们在多任务设置中使用了全部 50 个 RoboTwin 任务，并为每个任务使用 50 条干净的演示数据进行训练。 随机化分组评估了在没有随机化场景动作监督的情况下控制策略的泛化能力。 遵循（Chen 等人，2026a；Hu 等人，2026）的做法，视频专家通过来自干净和随机化场景的无动作视频进行训练，而视觉-动作微调则仅使用干净的演示数据。 因此，随机化分组评估了在没有动作标签的情况下学到的视觉知识，是否能够在显著变化的场景条件下支持动作生成。 观察数据由头部摄像头和两个手腕摄像头组成，合成到单个 384 × 320 的帧中（头部位于上方三分之二区域，左右手腕位于下方）。 我们遵循与 LIBERO 相同的两阶段流程，但有三个不同之处：(i) 使用三摄像头合成的 RoboTwin 数据而非两个摄像头；(ii) 采用较小的冷启动训练（RoboTwin 的规模约为 LIBERO 的 24 × 24 倍，因此仅视频适应训练约运行 1 个周期）；以及 (iii) 最佳子目标调度方案偏向于近期目标，使用更高的 k 值（K = 4，进度为 0.1、0.2、0.35、0.5）。 阶段 2 在干净分组数据上对动作头进行 5 个周期的联合训练，并使用相同的差异学习率。

paragraphs.en: RoboCasa365. RoboCasa365 ( Nasiriany et al., 2024 ) is a large-scale benchmark for generalist robot policies, spanning 365 everyday manipulation tasks across 2,500 diverse kitchen environments. Following the official multi-task protocol, policies are trained on the Human300 dataset, which contains human-teleoperated demonstrations for 300 tasks, and evaluated in closed loop on 50 target tasks. The evaluation comprises 18 Atomic-Seen , 16 Composite-Seen , and 16 Composite-Unseen tasks. The first two splits contain tasks observed during pretraining, whereas Composite-Unseen evaluates zero-shot generalization to held-out task compositions. We report success rates for each split and the mean success rate over all 50 tasks as the overall score. We follow the same two-stage recipe used for LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) and RoboTwin ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . As shown in Table 10 , in Stage 1, we pretrain the video expert on the RoboCasa demonstrations with the progressive sub-goal objective; in Stage 2, we jointly fine-tune the video expert and the action expert. The three simulated views (one top, two bottom) are composited into a single 448 × 448 448\times 448 image (top view across the upper region, wrist/side views below). Each clip spans 49 raw frames sampled at stride 3 (17 latent frames). Actions ( d a = 12 d_{a}=12 ) and proprioception ( d p = 16 d_{p}=16 ) are normalized using dataset statistics, and the action expert predicts a horizon of H = 32 H=32 . Sub-goals use a progressive- K K schedule with K max = 6 K_{\max}=6 and progress levels r ∈ { 0.3 , 0.4 , 0.5 , 0.65 , 0.8 , 0.9 } r\in\{0.3,0.4,0.5,0.65,0.8,0.9\} . We train at a global batch size of 1024 with a cosine schedule, learning rate 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} for the action expert and 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} for the video expert. We run the official RoboCasa closed-loop evaluator on three splits: atomic-seen ( 18 18 tasks), composite-seen ( 16 16 tasks), and composite-unseen ( 16 16 tasks), with 25 25 independent rollouts per task ( 450 450 / 400 400 / 400 400 trials respectively). At inference, the video expert is evaluated once per replanning step to obtain and cache the sub-goal key-value features. The action expert then reuses this cache over 10 10 action-denoising steps. The cache is refreshed when a new observation triggers the next replanning step, and executes the full predicted horizon before re-planning ( H = 32 H{=}32 , replan every 32 32 steps).
paragraphs.zh: RoboCasa365。 RoboCasa365（Nasiriany 等人，2024）是一个面向通用机器人策略的大规模基准数据集，涵盖 2500 个多样化厨房环境中的 365 项日常操作任务。 遵循官方的多任务协议，策略在 Human300 数据集上进行训练，该数据集包含人类远程操控的 300 项任务演示，并在 50 个目标任务上进行闭环评估。 评估包括 18 项 Atomic-Seen、16 项 Composite-Seen 和 16 项 Composite-Unseen 任务。 前两个分集包含预训练期间观察到的任务，而 Composite-Unseen 则评估模型对未见过任务组合的零样本泛化能力。 我们报告每个分集的成功率，以及全部 50 个任务的平均成功率作为总体得分。 我们遵循与 LIBERO（Liu 等人，2023）和 RoboTwin（Chen 等人，2025）相同的两阶段训练流程。 如表 10 所示，在阶段 1 中，我们使用渐进式子目标目标在 RoboCasa 演示数据上预训练视频专家；在阶段 2 中，我们联合微调视频专家和动作专家。 三个模拟视角（一个俯视、两个侧视）被合成为一张 448×448 的图像（俯视视角位于上半区域，手腕/侧视位于下方）。 每个片段包含以步长 3 采样的 49 帧原始帧（对应 17 帧潜在帧）。 动作（d_a = 12）和本体感知（d_p = 16）使用数据集统计量进行归一化，动作专家预测的时域长度为 H = 32。 子目标采用渐进式 K 调度，其中 K_max = 6，进度水平 r ∈ {0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.65, 0.8, 0.9}。 我们以全局批量大小 1024 进行训练，采用余弦调度，动作专家的学习率为 1×10⁻⁴，视频专家的学习率为 5×10⁻⁵。 我们在三个分集上运行官方的 RoboCasa 闭环评估器：atomic-seen（18 项任务）、composite-seen（16 项任务）和 composite-unseen（16 项任务），每项任务进行 25 次独立滚动执行（分别对应 450/400/400 次试验）。 在推理阶段，视频专家在每个重新规划步骤中评估一次，以获取并缓存子目标的关键值特征。 随后，动作专家在 10 个动作去噪步骤中重复使用此缓存。 当新的观测触发下一次重新规划步骤时，缓存会被刷新，并在重新规划前执行完整的预测时域（H = 32，每 32 步重新规划一次）。

paragraphs.en: We therefore decouple the two branches at inference. paragraphs.en: To test whether the action head can rely on the visual knowledge encoded by the pretrained video backbone without explicit sub-goal conditioning, we introduce ProWAM-Light , inspired by FastWAM’s fast-inference setting. ProWAM-Light masks sub-goal tokens during both training and inference, such that the action head conditions only on the current observation. At inference, a single video-expert forward pass constructs a current-observation key–value cache that is reused throughout action denoising. As shown in Table 12 , ProWAM-Light maintains high in-domain performance, but its OOD success decreases from 85.8 % 85.8\% to 80.3 % 80.3\% despite only a modest compute reduction ( 15.1 15.1 to 13.8 13.8 TFLOPs), demonstrating the benefit of explicit sub-goal conditioning for generalization.

paragraphs.en: We deploy the policy on a hardware and software setup that mirrors the original DROID setup ( Khazatsky et al., 2024 ) . We use a single Franka FR3 arm with a Zed Mini wrist-mounted camera and two Zed 2i exterior cameras. Monocular images used for inference are sourced from the left-rectified sensor from each camera to match the original DROID dataset. We evaluate on a Franka FR3 under randomized initial object configurations, with 5 5 trials per task. The four tasks are designed independently of the RoboLab suite and span basic pick-and-place, long-horizon multi-object assembly, contact-rich placement, and spatially grounded placement. All success criteria are fixed prior to evaluation and applied identically to every method, detailed evaluation criterion is in Table 14 . Figure 12 illustrates closed-loop visual sub-goal generation in our real-world experiments. Given the current observation, our model produces a temporally ordered visual plan across multiple task-progress levels, which guides subsequent action generation and enables more effective policy execution. While the generated sub-goals place less emphasis on fine-grained textures and photorealistic details, they accurately capture the task-relevant motion, object interactions, and spatial relationships required to complete the manipulation tasks.

paragraphs.en: We additionally evaluate ProWAM on ABC, a simulated bimanual manipulation benchmark that models a realistic dual-arm setup with two 7-DoF arms and head- and wrist-mounted cameras. The three cameras (head + two wrists) are composited into a single 384 × 320 384\times 320 image (head across the top two-thirds, wrists on the bottom third). paragraphs.en: We perform the closed-loop evaluation using the official ABC evaluator. Each run covers 20 independent worlds, and each rollout is 120 action chunks of 15 executed steps. We report the strict AVG (all six bottles placed in the bin) and the mean maximum number of bottles placed (out of 6). Both our policy and the official policy are evaluated on the same 20 seed-matched worlds, and both face the same training and evaluation renderer gap. paragraphs.en: Table 15 reports the main comparison. Our policy succeeds in 7 of 20 evaluated worlds, compared with 1 of 20 for the official ABC policy, and achieves a higher mean bottle count (4.85 versus 4.10). paragraphs.en: While ProWAM demonstrates strong performance across diverse benchmarks, our study has several limitations that open promising avenues for future work:
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 ProWAM 在各种基准测试中表现出色，但我们的研究仍存在若干局限性，这些局限性为未来的工作开辟了充满希望的方向：

paragraphs.en: Manually Specified Inference Schedule. Although ProWAM supports variable sub-goal counts and progress values, the inference schedule is manually specified rather than inferred from the current task state or complexity. Learning to select the number and placement of sub-goals adaptively is a promising direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 手动指定的推理计划。 尽管 ProWAM 支持可变数量的子目标和进度值，但其推理计划是手动指定的，而不是根据当前任务状态或复杂程度推断得出的。 学习自适应地选择子目标的数量和位置，是未来工作的一个有前景的方向。

paragraphs.en: Model and Pre-training Scale: We build on a moderately sized video expert and a compact action expert. Due to compute constraints, we do not explore how scaling up the backbone size or pre-training corpora impacts performance, which we leave for future exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 模型与预训练规模：我们基于一个中等规模的视频专家和一个紧凑的动作专家进行构建。 由于计算资源限制，我们没有研究扩大主干网络规模或增加预训练语料库对性能的影响，这部分内容留待未来探索。

paragraphs.en: Task Diversity: Although our evaluation includes several multi-stage tasks, the tested horizons remain limited compared with extended real-world deployments, and evaluation on more dexterous tasks remains an important direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 任务多样性：尽管我们的评估包含多个多阶段任务，但与更广泛的实际部署场景相比，所测试的时间跨度仍然有限，因此在更多需要精细操作的任务上进行评估，仍然是未来研究的重要方向。
